map.📖 查看「文本转盲文使用指南」: 📖 View the "Text to Braille User Guide"
map.盲文用 6 点单元（2 列 × 3 行）表示字符，Unicode 在 U+280: Braille represents characters with a 6-dot cell (2 columns × 3 rows); Unicode assigns a code point to each dot pattern starting at U+2800. Enter text to convert it character by character into Braille, convenient for tactile reading and accessible layout preview.
map.盲文按 6 点单元（2 列 × 3 行）编码，点位编号 1 至 6；Unicod: Braille is encoded by a 6-dot cell (2 columns × 3 rows), dot positions numbered 1 to 6; Unicode code point = U+2800 + dot bitmask (each dot weight 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, summed and added to U+2800); e.g. a is dot 1, i.e. U+2801, b is dots 1 and 2, i.e. U+2803; Chinese characters are first converted to pinyin and then spelled by Braille rules, and digits have the prefix U+283C.
map.盲文基础拉丁字母 a–j 对应点 1–5，k–t 在 a–j 基础上加第 6 点: Basic Braille Latin letters a–j correspond to dots 1–5; k–t add the 6th dot (dots 3-6) on top of a–j; the rest of the letters have dedicated dot combinations.
map.数字 1–0 复用 a–j 的点字，前置 # 号（数符）区分；本工具直接输出数字: Digits 1–0 reuse the dot patterns of a–j, distinguished by a leading # (number sign); this tool outputs digit dot patterns directly.
map.完整英语盲文还包含大写前缀（⠠）、数字前缀（⠼）及缩写（contractions: Complete English Braille also includes the capital prefix (⠠), the number prefix (⠼) and contractions; formal layout needs dedicated rules.
map.把英文单词、数字或短句转成盲文: Convert English words, digits or short sentences into Braille
map.（⠿），用于盲文教学、无障碍演示或趣味展示。: (⠿), for Braille teaching, accessibility demos or fun display.
map.做无障碍（a11y）科普时，直观呈现“文字→盲文点字”的映射，帮助理解点字系统。: When doing accessibility (a11y) popular science, intuitively present the "text → Braille dot pattern" mapping to help understand the dot system.
map.转成盲文点字作为视觉元素（注意：仅作展示，非真实盲文排版）。: into Braille dot patterns as a visual element (note: display only, not real Braille layout).
map.映射 a–z、0–9 及常用标点：H→⠓、e→⠑、l→⠇、l→⠇、o→⠕、空格保: Map a–z, 0–9 and common punctuation: H→⠓, e→⠑, l→⠇, l→⠇, o→⠕, space kept, 1→⠂, 2→⠆, 3→⠒, !→⠖. Thus "Hello 123!" → "⠓⠑⠇⠇⠕ ⠂⠆⠒⠖".
map.不区分（都按小写点字）。: Not distinguished (all treated as lowercase dot patterns).
map.支持中文和标点吗？: Does it support Chinese and punctuation?
map.内置 a–z、0–9 与部分英文标点（. , ? ! : ; - ' ( )）的: Built-in Braille mappings for a–z, 0–9 and some English punctuation (. , ? ! : ; - ' ( )) are provided; Chinese is out of scope and is kept or ignored as-is, depending on the implementation.
map.本工具按单字符直接映射（grade 1 盲文思路），未做缩写与连写；真实盲文排版: This tool maps each single character directly (grade 1 Braille idea), without abbreviations or contractions; real Braille layout (grade 2) uses many abbreviations — sufficient for display purposes, but do not treat it as formal Braille.
